groups.title: Questions 51 to 55 are based on the following passage.

runs.text: What do we learn about publicity over protein in America?

Why have physicians in the U.S. never actually examined a patient with protein deficiency?

Sugar-free snacks.
Both red and white meats.
Protein-rich foods.
Sugary and fatty foods.
